clue.text: State needing friendship in disaster

parts.note: Cal. is a standard abbreviation for California, a US state
amity is friendly relations, friendship

explanation.surface: A country in crisis turns to its friends for help.
explanation.definitionFit: A calamity is a great misfortune or catastrophe, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Punch nose

definitions.meaning: to hit someone, especially on the head
old British slang for the nose

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are informal British slang: a blow to the head and a large nose.

clue.text: Golf course reports wild cat

indicators.note: reports suggests something spoken, so the words are heard rather than read

parts.note: links is a seaside golf course

explanation.surface: News comes in of a wild cat seen on the golf course.
explanation.definitionFit: The lynx is a short-tailed wild cat of forests in Europe, Asia and North America.

clue.text: Came upon French knight in London's suburbs

parts.note: to come upon someone is to meet them, past tense met
Roland is the paladin of Charlemagne in the French epic Chanson de Roland

explanation.surface: A medieval hero turns up unexpectedly among the commuter suburbs.
explanation.walkthrough: Metro-land was the name given to the suburbs north-west of London served by the Metropolitan Railway, celebrated by Betjeman, the puzzle's theme.
explanation.definitionFit: Metroland is the popular name for the suburban district around the Metropolitan line out of London.

clue.text: Normal-looking score draw

definitions.meaning: ... describes perfect normal eyesight, from the 20/20 sight test result
a score is twenty, so a drawn game ending twenty all is ...

explanation.definitionFit: 20/20 is normal visual acuity, and 20-20 is a tied score of two scores each.

clue.text: Dead skin our poet wanted destroyed

definitions.meaning: Betjeman wrote Come, friendly bombs, and fall on this Berkshire town

explanation.definitionFit: Slough is shed dead skin, and the Berkshire town Betjeman's poem asked to be bombed.

clue.text: Old king touring hospital to find composer

indicators.note: touring means going round, so the king's name goes around the other letter

parts.note: Lear is the legendary ancient British king of Shakespeare's play
H is the abbreviation for hospital on road signs and maps

explanation.surface: An aged monarch on a hospital visit finds a musician.
explanation.definitionFit: Franz Lehár was the Hungarian composer of the operetta The Merry Widow.

clue.text: Intolerable, taking time for run? That would be best

indicators.note: taking one thing for another means swapping it in place of it
for marks what is put in place of the replaced letter

parts.note: something intolerable is unbearable
R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for a run

explanation.surface: An athlete's race time is so good it is unbearable to rivals: nobody could beat it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that could not be bettered is the best, the meaning of unbeatable.

clue.text: Subaltern's intended taking horse over, we hear

parts.note: a hunter is a horse bred for fox hunting

indicators.note: we hear signals that the next word is taken by its sound

parts.note: over means finished, done

explanation.surface: A young officer's fiancée takes a horse on, as people say.
explanation.walkthrough: Miss J. Hunter Dunn is the sporting girl whom the subaltern hopes to marry in Betjeman's poem A Subaltern's Love-song.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Betjeman poem the subaltern becomes engaged to Miss Joan Hunter Dunn.

clue.text: Games on square that make batsmen nervous

indicators.note: in an across clue, one piece on another means after it

parts.note: nine is the square of three
ties are matches or games, as in cup ties

explanation.surface: Matches on the cricket square that leave the batting side jittery.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a batsman scoring between 90 and 99 is in the nervous nineties, anxious about getting out before reaching a century.
explanation.definitionFit: Scores in the nineties are notorious for making batsmen nervous as they near a hundred.

clue.text: Article written to outlaw ancient Greek

parts.note: the is the definite article
to outlaw something is to ban it

explanation.surface: An article is written in order to have an old Greek prohibited.
explanation.definitionFit: A Theban is a native of Thebes, a leading city of ancient Greece.

clue.text: Official transport cops rent freely

parts.note: a taxi is a form of transport

indicators.note: freely suggests the letters are arranged without restriction

explanation.surface: A transport official is hit by police charging rent freely.
explanation.definitionFit: A tax inspector is a revenue officer who checks people's tax affairs.

clue.text: Imaginative writer composing a literature, one Queen picked out

definitions.text: Imaginative writer composing a literature, one Queen picked out

parts.note: Edgar Allan Poe was a famously imaginative American writer of tales

indicators.note: composing means putting together, so the letters are rearranged
picked out means removed from the group of letters

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
R stands for Regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: A creative writer produces literature and is selected by the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'picked out' takes I and R from A LITERATURE, and 'composing' rearranges what is left; read whole, the clue describes the Queen's choice of poet.
explanation.definitionFit: The Poet Laureate is a writer appointed by the monarch, a post Betjeman held from 1972.

clue.text: How Prince spitefully described his times lacking roast meat?

definitions.text: How Prince spitefully described his times
definitions.meaning: Prince Hamlet says the time is ..., O cursed spite
having no joint, a roast cut of meat

explanation.definitionFit: Out of joint means disordered, as Hamlet calls his age, and literally without a joint of meat.

clue.text: Clothing article discarded by Führer, not initially picked

indicators.note: something discarded by a word is dropped from it

parts.note: Führer is German for leader
a is the indefinite article

indicators.note: not initially means without the first letter

parts.note: picked means chosen

explanation.surface: An item of clothing thrown out by Hitler and not chosen at first.
explanation.definitionFit: Lederhosen are leather shorts traditionally worn in Bavaria and the Alps.

clue.text: Scholars contributed to spiteful email

indicators.note: contributed to means the answer is part of the text that follows

explanation.surface: Academics added their part to a nasty email.
explanation.definitionFit: The ulema are the body of Muslim scholars trained in Islamic law and theology.

clue.text: To follow directors, one drops behind

parts.note: to tail someone is to follow them
a company's directors form its board

explanation.surface: Junior staff trail after the directors, one falling back.
explanation.definitionFit: A tailboard is the hinged back flap of a lorry or cart that drops down for loading.

clue.text: Leaving forces up, 20 went in and made repeated attacks — on 5 perhaps?

indicators.note: went in means one piece is placed inside the other
in a down clue, up means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: demob is demobilisation, leaving the armed forces
the poet at 20 across is a bard

explanation.surface: Leaving the forces, the poet went in and attacked Slough repeatedly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reads the forces word from bottom to top, giving BOMED, and 'went in' puts the poet inside. The tail recalls 5, Slough, which Betjeman asked friendly bombs to fall on.
explanation.definitionFit: To bombard is to attack repeatedly with bombs or shells, as Betjeman wished on Slough.

clue.text: Where coat's worn to look very smart

definitions.meaning: a coat goes over a dress
to dress too formally or elaborately for an occasion

explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words, over dress, it places the coat; as one verb it means dressing up too much.

clue.text: Honey's available for fruit

parts.note: mel is Latin for honey, used in pharmacy
on means available, as a dish on the menu

explanation.surface: Honey is offered as an alternative to fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A melon is a large juicy fruit of the gourd family.

clue.text: Self-described hack had two judges, both Anne and me, raving

parts.note: J is the abbreviation for judge

indicators.note: raving means wild or mad, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: J is the abbreviation for judge, the second of the pair

explanation.surface: A journalist calls himself a hack after facing two judges in court with his friends.
explanation.walkthrough: Betjeman often called himself a hack, from his years of journalism.
explanation.definitionFit: Betjeman, the poet and broadcaster, described himself modestly as a hack writer.

clue.text: English part of speech lifted accent on Maureen vowel

clue.text: Commotion closed party

parts.note: a door pushed to is closed
a do is a party or celebration

explanation.surface: A row breaks out at a private party.
explanation.definitionFit: A to-do is a fuss or commotion, a colloquial synonym.

clue.text: Being in middle of ship

indicators.note: middle of means the first and last letters are dropped

parts.note: a vessel is a ship

explanation.surface: Life amidships on board a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: Esse is the Latin word for to be, used in English for existence or essential being.

clue.text: Part of foot dancers keep carefully

definitions.meaning: the arched upper middle of the foot
dancers take care to move in time together

explanation.definitionFit: The instep is the arch of the foot; in step is what dancers carefully stay.

clue.text: Boss promises to pay for showing diligence

parts.note: a boss is a stud, a raised knob
IOUs are written promises to pay a debt

explanation.surface: The employer offers promissory notes in return for hard work.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone studious applies themselves diligently to study.

clue.text: Heard bell's note

indicators.note: heard tells us the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: the tenor is the largest and lowest bell in a ring

explanation.surface: Someone hears the sound of a bell ringing a particular musical note.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenner is a ten-pound banknote, a note in the money sense.

clue.text: Signal of coming trouble may galvanise Catholic Church

parts.note: to galvanise someone into action is to prod them
Rome stands for the Roman Catholic Church

explanation.surface: A warning sign might stir the Catholic Church into action.
explanation.definitionFit: A prodrome is an early symptom, a warning that an illness or attack is coming.
